Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q1 2020 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of MSFT.
Our gross margin expanded by 43 basis points to 68.5%, reflecting improved operational efficiency.
Revenue guidance of $23.5 billion assumes no further deterioration in consumer spending trends.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q1 2020.
Our cloud segment grew 23% year-over-year, driven by strong enterprise demand.
We expect revenues to grow approximately 23% to 27% next quarter, subject to market conditions.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
Can you clarify whether the margin expansion is sustainable into next year given rising input costs?
Thank you for the question. We delivered record revenue of $23.5 billion this quarter, representing 23% year-over-year growth.
Second question - Analyst:
How are you thinking about pricing power versus volume growth in the current environment?
Our outlook assumes current foreign exchange rates hold; currency fluctuations could materially affect results.
